messages:
deploy-bot: Pre-promotion check: chart=billing-v6.0 found feature-flag drift: billing.enableNewBillingFlow expected=false actual=true in 2/12 canary pods. severity=warn. observed job=run-billing-migration triggered in canary. cmd: `kubectl -n prod get jobs -l app=billing -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'`
anna_eng: yikes — the migration job explains the DB write spikes. Where did this flag change come from?
kai: promoted chart is v6.0 (no migration flag). overlay `team-billing/canary-values.yaml` set `billing.enableNewBillingFlow: true` and `billing.migration.runOnDeploy: true`. Looks like the overlay slipped into the branch.
rachel: change window still open for 3h. Options: block promotion, pin flag=false for main rollout, or proceed and isolate canary. We should avoid running migration broadly mid-window. I vote pin=false and retain canary for diagnostics.
anna_eng: proposed commands:
```bash
# promote main but pin feature flag off
helm upgrade billing-release charts/billing --namespace prod --version 6.0.0 \
  --reuse-values \
  --set billing.enableNewBillingFlow=false \
  --set billing.migration.runOnDeploy=false \
  --set imagePromotion.meta=pin-featureflag-2026-05-03
# ensure canary label kept for investigation
kubectl -n prod label deployment billing-svc release-type=canary --overwrite
```
kai: rollback surface: if pinned rollout causes regressions, `helm rollback billing-release 11` and undo pin. If migration job already started in canary and is interfering, scale canary to zero: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy billing-svc --replicas=0 -l release-type=canary` and delete the job: `kubectl -n prod delete job <job-name>` to stop ongoing migration attempts.
rachel: add release-notes blurb: "Pinned billing.enableNewBillingFlow=false during rollout; canary instances ran migration job. Follow-up: reconcile overlays and schedule coordinated migration window." Create ticket RD-6144.
deploy-bot: created short watch: billing-migration-watch (60m). thresholds: db_write_rate>0.05, job_failure_count>0, pod_restart_count>2.
kai: helm dry-run diff (snippet):
```diff
--- a/templates/deployment.yaml
+++ b/templates/deployment.yaml
@@
-        - name: ENABLE_NEW_BILLING_FLOW
-          value: "true"
+        - name: ENABLE_NEW_BILLING_FLOW
+          value: "false"  # pinned for rollout
@@
-        - name: RUN_MIGRATION_ON_DEPLOY
-          value: "true"
+        - name: RUN_MIGRATION_ON_DEPLOY
+          value: "false"  # pinned for rollout
```
anna_eng: created RD-6144 and added to release notes. tagging ops and eng-qa.
release-manager: decision: proceed with pinned promote and maintain canary pods for postmortem. @kai execute after helm dry-run verified. include audit tag on helm values. Close thread after watch if stable.
kai: promote executed at 3985001265. Helm upgrade succeeded, rollout complete. Canary (2 pods) still running with enableNewBillingFlow=true and a migration job present for analysis.
rachel: metrics look stable after deploy. will monitor the billing-migration-watch.
release-manager: follow-up: schedule coordinated migration with DB team and reconcile overlays in next patch release. closing thread after watch. :white_check_mark:
